info.title: Proxmate API
info.description: Single-admin LAN API. Configuration writes are immediate; infrastructure actions run in a serialized durable queue. Guest management requires reviewing a frozen plan, then confirming its ID. No automatic retries or rollback.

post.summary: Validate and preview a provisioning flow
post.description: Pure validation; no Proxmox calls. Returned XML preview redacts password. POST /api/jobs with action=provision and confirmed=true to execute. Optional bootstrap prepares SSH/WinRM and guest-agent installation; the response includes a bootstrap_preview. verify=true requires VM purpose, start=true and a matching credential reference. Verification reads only public trust material through authenticated Proxmox guest-agent APIs, then authenticates with TLS/SSH checks enabled and saves a connection.

post.description: Read-only Proxmox inspection. Returns id, exact targets, tasks, settings, notes and dangerous flag. Plan expires after 30 minutes. post.summary: Review recovery or template lifecycle operation
post.description: Read-only Proxmox inspection. backup-restore requires node/vmid/storage/name/archive; refuses occupied IDs, creates unique identities and leaves the new VM stopped. Optional boot_test requires disconnected=true. backup-retention requires node/backup_storage/source_vmid, keep and older_than_days; returns exact candidates and preserves protected/newest archives. version-build requires family_id/recipe_id/vmid/name/label and optional start; Windows builds require fresh licensing/disk confirmation. Recipe tasks run only after verified bootstrap; otherwise remain planned. version-register requires family_id/node/vmid/label/prepared=true; stopped guests are converted and onboot disabled. template-test and version-clone require version_id/node/vmid/storage/name; testing always disconnects networking, boot-checks and retains the clone. version-promote requires version_id and successful test evidence tied to unchanged config. Plans expire after 30 minutes.

post.summary: Save opt-in backup restore-check or retention policy
post.description: Defaults disabled; retention defaults to preview only. auto_delete requires risk_confirmed=true. Restore checks select latest backup for exactly one source VM/storage and an unused destination ID in the reserved range (at most 1000 IDs). Copies remain disconnected and retained. Full scratch range skips instead of reusing/deleting. UTC windows and intervals; missed and overlapping occurrences skipped. No external notifications.
